title: Lesson 77 · A successful operation
titleZh: 第77课 一例成功的手术

examples.zh: 这具木乃伊做了一次手术。

examples.en: The mummy is that of an Egyptian woman.
examples.zh: 这具木乃伊是一位埃及妇女的。

examples.en: The operation lasted for over four hours.
examples.zh: 手术持续了四个多小时。

examples.en: She was a singer in the Temple of Thebes.
examples.zh: 她是底比斯神庙里的歌手。
谢佩姆特曾是一名歌手。

examples.en: The doctors studied the X-ray plates.
There were strange marks on the plates.
The X-ray plates showed strange marks.
examples.zh: X光片显示出奇怪的斑点。

examples.en: The doctors wanted to know if she died of a rare disease.
examples.zh: 医生们想知道她是否死于一种罕见的疾病。
坚硬的树脂覆盖着皮肤。

examples.en: The mummy's skin was covered with resin.
examples.zh: 木乃伊的皮肤上覆盖着树脂。

examples.en: They removed a section of the mummy.
examples.zh: 他们切下了木乃伊的一部分。

examples.en: They sent the section to a laboratory.
examples.zh: 他们把切片送到了实验室。

examples.en: They found a small wax figure.
examples.zh: 他们发现了一个小蜡像。

examples.en: The wax figure was the god Duamutef.
examples.zh: 那个蜡像是杜阿姆特夫神。
谢佩姆特死于公元前800年。

sentences.en: There were strange marks on the X-ray plates, so doctors wanted to find out how the woman died.
sentences.zh: X光片上有奇怪的斑点，因此医生们想查明这位妇女的死因。

sentences.en: The doctors decided on an operation, and it lasted for over four hours.
sentences.zh: 医生们决定进行手术，手术持续了四个多小时。

sentences.en: The operation was very difficult because hard resin covered the skin.
sentences.zh: 手术非常困难，因为坚硬的树脂覆盖着皮肤。

sentences.en: The doctors feared that the mummy would fall to pieces when they cut it open.
sentences.zh: 医生们担心切开时木乃伊会碎成碎片。

sentences.en: Fortunately, this did not happen, and the mummy successfully survived the operation.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，这种情况没有发生，木乃伊成功挺过了手术。

article.en: The mummy of an Egyptian woman who died in 800 B.C. has just had an operation.
article.zh: 一位死于公元前800年的埃及妇女的木乃伊刚刚接受了一次手术。

article.en: The mummy is that of Shepenmut, who was once a singer in the Temple of Thebes.
article.zh: 这具木乃伊是谢佩姆特的，她生前是底比斯神庙里的歌手。

article.en: There were strange marks on the X-ray plates, so doctors wanted to find out how the woman died.
article.zh: X光片上有奇怪的斑点，因此医生们想查明这位妇女的死因。

article.en: The doctors decided on an operation, and it lasted for over four hours.
article.zh: 医生们决定进行手术，手术持续了四个多小时。

article.en: The operation was very difficult because hard resin covered the skin.
article.zh: 手术非常困难，因为坚硬的树脂覆盖着皮肤。

article.en: The doctors removed a section of the mummy and sent it to a laboratory.
article.zh: 医生们切下木乃伊的一部分，送到了实验室。

article.en: They also found a small wax figure of the god Duamutef, which the X-ray plates did not show.
article.zh: 他们还发现了一个X光片没有显示出来的小蜡像——杜阿姆特夫神像。

article.en: This god, which has the head of a cow, was normally placed inside a mummy.
article.zh: 这个长着牛头的神通常被放在木乃伊体内。

article.en: The doctors feared that the mummy would fall to pieces when they cut it open.
article.zh: 医生们担心切开时木乃伊会碎成碎片。

article.en: Fortunately, this did not happen, and the mummy successfully survived the operation.
article.zh: 幸运的是，这种情况没有发生，木乃伊成功挺过了手术。
